scope: all portal quotes and WhatsApp-origin quote requests
minor_rule: When any passenger is a minor, Concierge must explicitly validate accompaniment, parent/guardian authorization requirements, passport/ID requirements, airline/carrier requirements where applicable and destination-entry rules before finalizing the quote.
health_rule: Vaccination, health certificate and sanitary-entry requirements must be checked against current official sources for the passenger nationality, origin/transit and destination before final quote delivery.
consular_rule: For Brazilian passengers, use destination-country official consular/immigration sources plus Brazil MRE/Portal Consular where applicable. For foreign passengers entering Brazil, use Brazil MRE/consular network and Polícia Federal immigration guidance, filtered by nationality.

routing.whatsapp_inbound: n8n/Meta webhook -> normalize contact -> identify quote intent -> collect mandatory fields -> enrich with consular gate -> Concierge priority queue
routing.portal_quote: portal quote -> require nationality -> consular gate -> generate quote -> Concierge/agent review -> send
